visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of zoomable 16:9 image tiles opening a lightbox slider
visualCharacteristics.layout: 1 / 2 / 4 tiles per row in a 10-column frame
notable: Shows 8 tiles initially (4 below 720px) with a Mehr anzeigen button for the rest
Lightbox with prev/next, close, backdrop click and Escape
Image title shown below the image in the lightbox

contentPattern.structure: One cell per image: a picture paragraph and a heading used as the image title

usage: Use for a photo gallery where visitors can enlarge and browse images
reuseGuidance: Fits sets of standalone photos with short titles; not for linked teasers or images needing body text
